artist.name: DISCOKID
artist.bio: Discokid is the DJ name of Fatema Hakim, a disco and funk DJ from India. Her property Paradise Disco hosted the first Disco Diwali in 2021. She played Mixmag's The Lab Goa in January 2022.

eras.sound: Laid-back funk, glittery disco and sultry house
